select #{uid} uid, s.id,u.user_name userName,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name, s.top_type, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.contract, s.filing, s.state ,s.PA ,s.PB, MAX(CASE WHEN s.first_person_id = sc.userid AND s.id = sc.sciIntraSch_Id THEN sc.earnedALL_Points END) AS firstPoints, MAX(CASE WHEN s.second_person_id = sc.userid AND s.id = sc.sciIntraSch_Id THEN sc.earnedALL_Points END) AS secondPoints, MAX(CASE WHEN s.third_person_id = sc.userid AND s.id = sc.sciIntraSch_Id THEN sc.earnedALL_Points END) AS thirdPoints, MAX(CASE WHEN s.fourth_person_id = sc.userid AND s.id = sc.sciIntraSch_Id THEN sc.earnedALL_Points END) AS forthPoints from sci_IntraSchPro_apply s left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id LEFT JOIN sci_IntraSchPro_score sc ON sc.sciIntraSch_Id = s.id where s.state = 6
and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%')
and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{dname}, '%') and state = #{state}
GROUP BY s.id, u.user_name, d.dept_name, p.dept_name, s.user_id, s.top_name, s.top_type, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, s.fourth_person_id, CONCAT(s.amount, '万'), s.contract, s.filing, s.state, s.PA, s.PB order by createtime desc

where s.state in (2,4) and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%')
